hint.en: sandbox, deny rules, size of the enforced set

hint.zh: plan 模式、访谈、完成标准

practices.title: Clear context between unrelated tasks
practices.title_zh: 无关任务之间用 /clear 清空上下文

sources.quote: /clear between unrelated tasks. It costs nothing…
sources.fragment: between unrelated tasks

sources.quote: after two failed corrections run /clear and write a better prompt instead of a third
sources.fragment: after two failed corrections run

sources.quote: Keep one chat per coherent unit of work.
sources.fragment: Keep one chat per coherent unit of work

practices.detect: Summary: long_sessions, corrections_per100_prompts vs cohorts.long.corr_per100, cohorts.long.cleared (a new human session in the same directory, any account or host, handoffs included), pct_started_by_clear.

rule.text: Proxy: relatedness is not logged; one long task is fine. Long = over 200 tool calls. Cleared = a new human session (/clear, /new, other account or host, handoff) in the same directory within 10 min of its end. ok: <10% long, or >=20% of long sessions cleared; part: >=30% long and more corrections per prompt when long (hosts with >=10 long); else na (heuristic)

practices.title: Send verbose exploration to subagents so only a summary returns
practices.title_zh: 输出多的工作交给 subagent

sources.quote: the verbose output stays in the subagent's context while only a summary returns to your main conversation.
sources.fragment: the verbose output stays in the subagent

sources.quote: Delegate the exploration so only the findings come back.
sources.fragment: Delegate the exploration so only the findings come back

practices.detect: Summary: cohorts.wide (reads include linked subagent transcripts), agent_types_calls.

rule.text: Cohort: human sessions with >=30 read/search calls, linked subagent reads included. Offloaded = a linked subagent did reads itself (any subagent call if the host links none); only its final message returns. ok: offloaded in >=20%; part: some; no: none; na: <10 in cohort (heuristic)

practices.title: Give simple subagents a cheaper model (model: haiku)
practices.title_zh: 简单的 subagent 用便宜模型（model: haiku）

sources.quote: Set model: haiku in a subagent's definition if its work is simple
sources.fragment: if its work is simple

sources.quote: For simple subagent tasks, specify model: haiku in your subagent configuration.
sources.fragment: For simple subagent tasks

practices.detect: Config: claude[] / claude_projects[] custom_subagents; the judge reads agents/*.md for a model field.

rule.text: na without agents/*.md definitions. Else semantic (logs do not show which work is simple): ok: every simple-looking definition sets model: haiku or another smaller model; part: some; no: none; na: none looks simple.

practices.title: Tell /compact what to keep, or put Compact instructions in CLAUDE.md
practices.title_zh: /compact 时说明要保留什么，或在 CLAUDE.md 写 Compact instructions

sources.quote: /compact Focus on code samples and API usage tells Claude what to preserve during summarization.
sources.fragment: tells Claude what to preserve during summarization

sources.quote: You can also customize compaction behavior in your CLAUDE.md file at the root of your project
sources.fragment: customize compaction behavior in your CLAUDE.md file

practices.detect: Summary: hosts.<h>.compact_cmds, compact_focus (/compact with arguments); config: instruction files' compact_instructions (heading), compact_notes.

rule.text: ok: a 'Compact instructions' heading, or >=50% of typed /compact commands with a focus; part: some with a focus, or compaction notes without the heading; no: >=3 typed /compact, none with a focus, no heading or notes; else na. Auto-compaction is not judged (heuristic)

practices.title: Keep approvals and sandboxing tight by default; give full access only as an exception
practices.title_zh: 审批和沙箱默认收紧，全权限只作例外

sources.quote: the lower-risk local automation preset is sandbox_mode = "workspace-write" together with approval_policy = "on-request"
sources.fragment: the lower-risk local automation preset is

sources.quote: Giving Codex full permission to your computer before you understand the workflow
sources.fragment: Giving Codex full permission to your computer

sources.quote: Use danger-full-access only in a controlled environment
sources.fragment: only in a controlled environment

sources.quote: Keep approval and sandboxing tight by default, then loosen permissions only for trusted repos or specific workflows once the need is clear.
sources.fragment: Keep approval and sandboxing tight by default

practices.detect: Summary: full_access_sessions, modes_sessions; config: codex[].approval_policy / sandbox_mode.

rule.text: Full access = no approval and no sandbox in one turn (Claude bypass, Grok yolo, Codex never + danger-full-access); today's sandbox is not applied to past sessions. Trusted repos and controlled environments, where the pages allow it, are not logged, so: ok: <20% of human sessions; part: 20-49%; no: >=50%, full access as the default (heuristic)

practices.title: Make rules that must hold every time a hook, a deny rule or a managed setting
practices.title_zh: 每次都必须执行的规则交给 hook、deny 规则或 managed setting

sources.quote: If something has to happen every time, make it a hook, a deny rule, or a managed setting.
sources.fragment: If something has to happen every time

practices.detect: Config: instruction files' must_rules, must_topics; claude[] / claude_projects[] hook_topics (every hook, by matcher and command), deny_topics. Managed settings are not scanned.

rule.text: Must-word lines (always, never, must, 必须...) stand in for 'has to happen every time'; topics (the audit's matcher): secrets, destructive, git_push, language. na without must lines. ok: every topic has a hook (any event) or deny rule; part: some, or hooks or denies on other topics; no: neither. A managed setting the user names counts.

practices.title: Keep the enforced set (hooks + deny rules) small
practices.title_zh: 强制规则（hook + deny）保持少量

sources.quote: Whatever the scope, keep the enforced set small. … If you ever find yourself at forty of them, most are probably preferences
sources.fragment: Whatever the scope, keep the enforced set small

practices.detect: Config: hook_entries + deny_count per active setup.

rule.text: Every hook entry plus every deny rule in the largest active setup. ok: <20; part: 20-39; no: >=40 (heuristic)

practices.title: Protect .env and secret files with deny rules
practices.title_zh: 用 deny 规则保护 .env 和密钥文件

sources.quote: deny rules hold in every permission mode, including auto and bypassPermissions, which is exactly why the .env rule belongs there
sources.fragment: rules hold in every permission mode

practices.detect: Config: settings deny_coverage (path-like rules only); modes_sessions for context.

rule.text: Path-like deny rules only. ok: .env files covered; part: only other secret paths (secrets/, key files, ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, cloud); no: none. The worst active setup decides (deny rules hold in every mode).

practices.title: Keep AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md short
practices.title_zh: AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md 保持短小

sources.quote: A short, accurate AGENTS.md is more useful than a long file full of vague rules.
sources.fragment: is more useful than a long file full of vague rules

sources.quote: target under 200 lines per CLAUDE.md file. Longer files consume more context and reduce adherence.
sources.fragment: target under 200 lines per

sources.quote: stops adding files once the combined size reaches the limit defined by project_doc_max_bytes (32 KiB by default)
sources.fragment: stops adding files once the combined size reaches the limit

practices.detect: Config: CLAUDE.md line counts (symlinks too); codex[].instruction_chain_bytes_max (repo AGENTS chain, root down) vs project_doc_max_bytes.

rule.text: part: a CLAUDE.md over 200 lines, or Codex's repository AGENTS chain over project_doc_max_bytes (default 32768 bytes = 32 KiB), where Codex stops adding files; ok: neither. No 'no': raising the cap is allowed.

practices.title: Put the commands that run your checks (build, test, lint) in the instruction file
practices.title_zh: 把跑检查的命令（build、test、lint）写进指令文件

sources.quote: the single most useful line in your CLAUDE.md is the command that runs it.
sources.fragment: the single most useful line in your

sources.quote: Build, test, and lint commands
sources.fragment: Build, test, and lint commands

practices.detect: Config: repo_instructions[].mentions_test / mentions_build / mentions_lint (real commands), grouped by repo (root and subdirectory AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md; global files exempt).

rule.text: Per repository. Check command = test, build, lint or typecheck (Claude: the command for whatever check exists; Codex lists build, test, lint). ok: every repository names one; part: some; no: none. Missing build/test/lint is listed, not scored.

practices.title: Update the rules when the same mistake happens twice
practices.title_zh: 同一错误出现两次就更新规则

sources.quote: When Codex makes the same mistake twice, ask it for a retrospective and update AGENTS.md.
sources.fragment: When Codex makes the same mistake twice

sources.quote: Start simple. Add rules only when you notice the agent making the same mistake repeatedly.
sources.fragment: Add rules only when you notice the agent making the same mistake repeatedly

sources.quote: When Claude makes a mistake twice, the correction goes into CLAUDE.md.
sources.fragment: the correction goes into CLAUDE.md

practices.detect: Instruction files show rule maintenance (recent edits, rules tied to observed failures, an eval or review loop); compare correction_categories counts. Judge from evidence; na if nothing can be seen.

rule.text: Semantic; na when nothing can be seen.

practices.title: Move workflow-specific instructions into on-demand skills
practices.title_zh: 流程类内容放 skill，按需加载

sources.quote: Skills load on-demand only when invoked, so moving specialized instructions into skills keeps your base context smaller.
sources.fragment: load on-demand only when invoked

sources.quote: Aim to keep CLAUDE.md under 200 lines by including only essentials.
sources.fragment: Aim to keep CLAUDE.md under 200 lines

practices.detect: Config: skill counts (active Claude roots, other_skills), CLAUDE.md lines; summary: concepts_pct.skill (context).

rule.text: Proxy: moving is not logged. Skills = Claude skills of active roots + ~/.codex/skills + ~/.agents/skills. part: a CLAUDE.md over 200 lines; ok: skills and every CLAUDE.md within 200 lines; na: neither skills nor a long CLAUDE.md.

practices.title: Plan before coding on complex tasks
practices.title_zh: 复杂任务先规划再写代码（plan 模式）

sources.quote: Claude reads files and proposes a plan but makes no edits until you approve.
sources.fragment: Claude reads files and proposes a plan but makes no edits until you approve

sources.quote: Plan mode lets Codex gather context, ask clarifying questions, and build a stronger plan before implementation.
sources.fragment: Plan mode lets Codex gather context

sources.quote: The most impactful change you can make is planning before coding.
sources.fragment: The most impactful change you can make is planning before coding

sources.quote: If the task is complex, ambiguous, or hard to describe well, ask Codex to plan before it starts coding.
sources.fragment: ask Codex to plan before it starts coding

practices.detect: Summary: cohorts.complex (plan = plan mode; plan_or_sub adds a planning skill or ask-user before the first edit).

rule.text: Cohort (proxy for complex tasks): >=5 files edited or >=100 tool calls (>=10 per group). Claude (logs plan mode): ok: plan mode >=25%; part: plan or substitute >=10%; else no. Other hosts: substitutes >=25% ok, >=10% part, else na. Session-weighted (heuristic)

practices.title: Ask the agent to interview you when you don't know exactly what you want yet
practices.title_zh: 还没想清楚要什么时，让 agent 先访谈你

sources.quote: Ask Claude to interview you instead
sources.fragment: Ask Claude to interview you instead

practices.detect: Summary: cohorts.complex.interview (ask-user or a grill/interview/brainstorm skill before the first edit).

rule.text: Option when you don't know what you want, which logs cannot see; complex sessions (>=5 files or >=100 tool calls) are the proxy. ok: interview in >=10%; below that na (no evidence either way); na: <10 in cohort (heuristic)

practices.title: State the done criteria in the prompt
practices.title_zh: 提示里写明完成标准（Done when）

sources.quote: Done when: What should be true before the task is complete, such as tests passing, behavior changing, or a bug no longer reproducing?
sources.fragment: What should be true before the task is complete

practices.detect: Usually na: needs semantic reading of prompts; pct_first_prompt_done_when is a keyword hint only.

rule.text: Semantic; usually na.

practices.title: Have the agent run pass/fail checks, with the output as evidence
practices.title_zh: 让 agent 跑能判定通过与否的检查，并留下输出作证据

sources.quote: Give Claude something it can run that comes back pass or fail.
sources.fragment: Give Claude something it can run that comes back pass or fail

sources.quote: ask Claude for evidence: the command it ran and its output, or the screenshot.
sources.fragment: the command it ran and its output, or the screenshot

sources.quote: Ask it to create tests when needed, run the relevant checks, confirm the result, and review the work before you accept it.
sources.fragment: Ask it to create tests when needed, run the relevant checks

sources.quote: Tests allow the agent to make changes, evaluate results, and incrementally improve until it succeeds.
sources.fragment: Tests allow the agent to make changes

practices.detect: Summary: pct_coding_with_check, pct_session_bash_tags, correction_categories.not_verified.

rule.text: Coding = edits or commits; check = test/lint/typecheck at command position, or a screenshot; its command and output stay in the transcript as evidence (pass or fail is not judged). ok: >=50% of coding sessions; part: 20-49%; no: <20% (heuristic)

practices.title: When output is wrong, revert and rerun with a sharper plan instead of patching
practices.title_zh: 输出不对就回滚重来，不继续打补丁

sources.quote: Revert the changes, refine the plan to be more specific about what you need, and run it again.
sources.fragment: Revert the changes, refine the plan

practices.detect: Usually na: reverts go through git, /rewind or manual edits; Grok signals.json hasReverted is a partial hint.

rule.text: na: no single log signal.

practices.title: Give each parallel piece of work its own checkout (git worktree)
practices.title_zh: 并行工作各用独立 checkout（git worktree）

sources.quote: When you have separate pieces of work going at once, give each its own checkout so the edits can't collide.
sources.fragment: give each its own checkout so the edits

sources.quote: Running live tasks on the same files without using Git worktrees
sources.fragment: Running live tasks on the same files without using Git worktrees

practices.detect: Summary: parallel (sessions, isolated, with_worktree, separate_clone): overlapping sessions that both edited files, grouped by git remote so clones of one repository meet; a worktree or another clone counts as isolated; cwd_top folds worktree dirs into their repo.

rule.text: Cohort: human sessions that edited files while another did in the same repo or a clone of it, overlapping >=5 min (sessions over 12 h ignored); same files not required. ok: worktree or separate clone in >=50%; part: some; no: none; na: <10 in cohort (heuristic)

practices.title: Run Claude non-interactively for CI, hooks and batch jobs
practices.title_zh: CI、git hook 和批处理用非交互（headless）模式跑

sources.quote: runs once and exits, which is how Claude Code ends up in CI jobs, git hooks, and shell loops.
sources.fragment: runs once and exits

sources.quote: Run Claude non-interactively for CI, pre-commit hooks, or batch processing.
sources.fragment: Run Claude non-interactively for CI

practices.detect: Summary: headless (sessions, self_audit, scheduled), human_repeated; config: schedulers.

rule.text: Headless = claude -p / codex exec / SDK sessions, own runs excluded. ok: any, or a scheduled headless job; else na (the pages describe use, not a duty). >=10 hand-typed sessions repeating a first-prompt shape >=3 times are listed as script candidates (heuristic)

practices.title: Give unattended runs a stop: --max-turns, --max-budget-usd or a spend limit
practices.title_zh: 无人值守运行设停止条件：轮数上限、花费上限或 spend limit

sources.quote: What stops it? --max-turns, --max-budget-usd, a spend limit.
sources.fragment: What stops it?

practices.detect: Config: schedulers and with_limits (--max-turns / --max-budget-usd in the job or its script). Spend limits are not visible locally.

rule.text: Unattended = scheduled headless jobs. na without them. ok: every job passes --max-turns or --max-budget-usd, or a spend limit the user names covers them; part: some; no: none.

practices.title: Compact before stepping away, while the prompt cache is warm
practices.title_zh: 离开前先 /compact，趁 prompt cache 还没过期

sources.page: Maximizing the value of your Claude Code sessions
sources.quote: /compact before you take a break from your keyboard.
sources.fragment: before you take a break from your keyboard

sources.page: Maximizing the value of your Claude Code sessions
sources.quote: the cache expires after an hour on a subscription or five minutes on an API key
sources.fragment: the cache expires after an hour

sources.page: Coding sessions are longer and use more context. Claude Opus 5.5 is built with that in mind.
sources.quote: Compact before you step away rather than after
sources.fragment: Compact before you step away

practices.detect: Session logs (needs extract support): idle gaps inside one human Claude session (including a later --resume into the same transcript) of >=60 min between the last assistant entry and the next user prompt; whether a /compact or compaction boundary came right before the gap. Billing type is not logged, so the subscription hour is used.

rule.text: Gap = >=60 min idle inside a human Claude session before more work. ok: >=50% of gaps preceded by /compact; part: 10-49%; no: <10%; na: <10 gaps (heuristic)
